item.title: Sherri Shepherd’s daytime talk show ‘Sherri’ canceled after four seasons in syndication
item.description: ‘Sherri,’ the daytime talk show hosted by Sherri Shepherd, has been canceled after four seasons in syndication. Debmar-Mercury, which both produces and distributes the series, said they plan to explore moving the show to a digital platform.
